C wf001.ps-read-owners OL WF-001 MUST ;; Before scaffolding read architecture.md, physical-structure.md and dependencies.md (path rules have not loaded for files that do not exist yet); with frontend scope also frontend.md and frontend-framework.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.ps-determine-scope OL ARC-027,GOV-013,DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Determine what the project actually needs before creating files; do not scaffold optional infrastructure merely because it may be useful later. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep002.ps-approved-stack OL DEP-002,DEP-015 MUST ;; Use the approved technologies of the technology stack and capability records; add conditional technologies only when their capability is required. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep003.ps-no-stale-versions OL DEP-003 MUST_NOT ;; Resolve every package version at install time through add-dependency; never copy stale versions from examples. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.ps-required-only OL ARC-027,DEP-024 MUST_NOT ;; Create only the required top-level directories and repository-wide files. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep008.ps-tfm OL DEP-008 DEFAULT ;; Create backend projects with the target framework from the technology stack. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.ps-listed-refs OL ARC-001,ARC-028 MUST_NOT ;; Add only the references listed in the backend layout; never add an outward dependency to make compilation easier. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep001.ps-baseline-packages OL DEP-002,DEP-003 MUST ;; Add baseline packages for capabilities present in the initial project through add-dependency. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep026.ps-dev-config OL DEP-026,PST-008 MUST ;; Create the local Development configuration from the persistence skill's project setup; Development seeding follows persistence-technology.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf019.ps-no-prod-automation OL WF-019,SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add Production credentials or Production migration automation while scaffolding. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.ps-verify OL WF-005,WF-003,ARC-001,DEP-026 MUST ;; Verify scaffolding: restore, build the solution and the frontend when present, run relevant tests, inspect project references with check-architecture.js, inspect the final tree, confirm the Development configuration, then run verify. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf009.ps-no-false-success OL WF-009,WF-005 MUST_NOT ;; Do not report successful scaffolding when the generated solution does not build. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.ps-responsibility OL ARC-027 MUST ;; Identify the architectural or technical responsibility of a later-added project. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.ps-min-refs OL ARC-001 MUST ;; Add only the minimum required references and preserve dependency direction. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep023.ps-shared-config OL DEP-023,DEP-006 DEFAULT ;; Update shared build/package configuration when a new project makes it necessary. ;; = ;; When necessary. ;;
C wf005.ps-build-test OL WF-005 MUST ;; Build and test the affected solution after adding a project. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.ps-no-sophistication OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Do not split code into additional projects to make the architecture look more sophisticated. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.ps-ref-read OL WF-001 MUST ;; Before changing project references read architecture.md (Dependency Direction, Test Project References) and backend-layout.md (Project References, Test References) if not loaded. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.ps-reorg OL GOV-014,ARC-027 MUST ;; Reorganize only for a concrete structural problem: inspect tree/references, preserve behaviour, small reviewable steps, consistent namespace/reference updates, no unrelated feature work, verify afterwards. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.ps-no-forced-template OL GOV-014,ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Do not force an established project to match this template when doing so provides no concrete value. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.ps-completion OL WF-005,ARC-001,ARC-027,GOV-014 MUST ;; Complete when structure matches the requested scope, references respect boundaries, baseline technology is used, no unnecessary projects/directories, backend (and frontend) build, relevant tests pass, Development configuration usable, no unrelated reorganization. ;; = ;; none ;;

C gov014.scan-no-upgrade OL GOV-014,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not upgrade a package during a scan unless asked. ;; = ;; Asked. ;;
C wf020.scan-severity OL WF-020 MUST ;; Severity from reachability, exposure and exploitability, not CVSS, pattern or OWASP category alone; a theoretical missing limit is not automatically High. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.scan-dependency-context OL WF-020 MUST ;; Distinguish production from development/build and direct from transitive dependency findings; development-only issues still matter to the supply chain but differ in runtime impact. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.scan-any-file OL SEC-001,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not automatically ignore appsettings.Development.json: a real committed secret is a secret regardless of file name; obviously fake values may be ignored or Info; UserSecretsId is not a secret. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec002.scan-mechanism OL SEC-002 MUST ;; Real secrets are supplied through the chosen local or deployment secret mechanism; review debug flags, validation bypass, credentialed URLs, verbose production errors and committed .env files. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec004.scan-parameterize OL SEC-004 DEFAULT ;; Prefer ORM LINQ, parameterized SQL, interpolation-aware raw-SQL APIs and ADO.NET/micro-ORM parameters. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.scan-no-pattern-findings OL WF-020,WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not report suspicious patterns as findings without context (ordinary LINQ predicates, every user-influenced query parameter as SSRF, ordinary template binding as XSS, non-security MD5/SHA1 checksums, entities assumed vulnerable without inspecting serialized fields). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-command-exec EX SEC-003 PREFER ;; Prefer APIs that separate executable and arguments; validate or constrain external input when command execution is genuinely needed. ;; = ;; Command execution genuinely needed. ;; Command-injection prevention is not stated in the oracle.
C x.scan-path-boundary EX SEC-003,SEC-015 MUST ;; Normalize user-controlled paths and verify they remain within the intended storage boundary (traversal, absolute-path injection, unsafe archive extraction). ;; = ;; none ;; Path-traversal invariant not in the oracle.
C x.scan-deserialization EX SEC-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not deserialize untrusted payloads into arbitrary runtime types (BinaryFormatter, unsafe TypeNameHandling). ;; = ;; none ;; Deserialization invariant not in the oracle.
C sec008.scan-crypto OL SEC-008,SEC-016,SEC-001 MUST ;; Flag security-sensitive MD5/SHA1/ECB, hardcoded keys, custom password hashing or home-grown encryption; expect established password-hashing facilities rather than reversible encryption. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.scan-effective-policy OL SEC-006,WF-020 MUST ;; Determine the effective authorization policy (fallback, attributes, policies, resource authorization); a missing [Authorize] under a secure fallback or a bare [Authorize] for simple authentication is not automatically a finding. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.scan-anonymous OL SEC-006,WF-012 MUST ;; Confirm public access is intentional; do not report every public endpoint as a vulnerability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec005.scan-idor OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Verify ownership, tenant, permission or resource policy where possession of an identifier could reach other users' data; client-side filtering is not authorization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec017.scan-token-validation OL SEC-017 MUST ;; Check Bearer/OIDC token validation; do not require manual setting of every TokenValidationParameters property or an arbitrary universal ClockSkew; flag intentionally disabled validation without valid reason. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec016.scan-accounts OL SEC-016,SEC-018 MUST_NOT ;; For local accounts review hashing, reset, lockout, enumeration and credential storage; do not recommend custom password hashing. ;; = ;; Application owns local accounts. ;;
C sec005.scan-frontend OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Verify sensitive operations are protected by the backend rather than only route guards or hidden controls. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec009.scan-cors OL SEC-009 MUST ;; CORS is not authorization; check origins against the browser-client model; AllowAnyOrigin can be valid for a public non-credentialed API; credentialed cross-origin access requires restricted origins. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec011.scan-csrf OL SEC-011 MUST ;; Review CSRF protection for state-changing operations when browser credentials are sent automatically; explicit Authorization-header bearer tokens differ. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec007.scan-tls OL SEC-007 MUST ;; Review disabled certificate validation, accept-all callbacks and plain HTTP for sensitive traffic; account for TLS termination; missing HTTPS redirection is not automatically a vulnerability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-rate-limiting EX WF-020 DEFAULT ;; Consider rate limiting where abuse could realistically matter (login, password reset, expensive anonymous or resource-intensive operations); do not require it on every endpoint. ;; = ;; none ;; Rate-limiting security expectation not in the oracle.
C sec010.scan-logging OL SEC-010,WF-012 MUST ;; Check logs against security.md; review PII per project requirements; Debug/Trace level is not a security boundary; do not demand logs for every successful request. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api008.scan-error-exposure OL API-008 MUST_NOT ;; Public errors must not reveal stack traces, SQL, connection strings, internal paths, secrets or internal exception details. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-response-contracts EX API-008 PREFER ;; Prefer explicit response contracts where needed instead of returning entities with hashes, internal security fields, unnecessary personal data or secret metadata. ;; = ;; Where needed. ;; Response-data minimization is not stated in the oracle.
C sec008.scan-data-at-rest OL SEC-008,SEC-016 DEFAULT ;; Choose data-at-rest protection by requirement: one-way password hashing, hashing for verification-only tokens, protected storage for retrievable secrets, platform/database encryption, Data Protection for temporary payloads. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec013.scan-fail-open OL SEC-013 MUST ;; Investigate code that catches an exception and lets a privileged operation continue (fail-open). ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec013.scan-swallowed OL SEC-013,API-007 MUST_NOT ;; Security-relevant failures must not silently become success; review empty/broad catches without deliberate fallback. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.scan-retry OL RUN-016,RUN-019 MUST ;; Review retries of state-changing operations (lost response + retry duplicates effects); caller cancellation is not a transient failure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec014.scan-startup OL SEC-014 MUST ;; Review security-sensitive startup configuration for dangerous fallback (auth silently disabled, plaintext mode, allow-all). ;; = ;; none ;;
C api007.scan-unexpected OL API-007,API-008 MUST ;; Unexpected exceptions follow the centralized error-handling policy and do not reveal sensitive information. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-design-review EX WF-020,WF-012 MUST ;; Identify security-sensitive workflows (tenant isolation, workflow abuse, privilege escalation, idempotency abuse, multi-step authorization) as threat-modeling/manual-review candidates rather than claiming a static scan proves them secure. ;; = ;; none ;; Design-review output obligation not in the oracle.
C x.scan-report-format EX WF-020 DEFAULT ;; Report each finding as [SEVERITY] path:line — title with OWASP category, Evidence, Impact and Remediation. ;; = ;; none ;; Report template not in the oracle.
C wf020.scan-needs-verification OL WF-020 MUST ;; When evidence is incomplete report the item as NEEDS VERIFICATION stating what effective behaviour depends on. ;; = ;; Evidence incomplete. ;;
C wf020.scan-no-invent-exploit OL WF-020,WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not invent exploitability that the code does not establish. ;; = ;; none ;;
